steps.command:
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
LC_ALL=C
export LC_ALL
as_root() {
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$@"
  else
    sudo -n "$@"
  fi
}
as_root sh -s <<'BASH_MATRIX_SEED'
# POSIX sh; works with GNU coreutils and BusyBox. No guest Python dependency.
set -eu
umask 022
LC_ALL=C
TZ=UTC0
export LC_ALL TZ
seed_root=/srv/legacy2/tftp-firmware-distribution
staging=
trap '[ -z "$staging" ] || rm -f "$staging"' 0
trap 'exit 1' 1 2 15

safe_dir() (
    [ ! -L "$1" ] || { printf 'Symlink directory: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
    if [ -e "$1" ]; then
        [ -d "$1" ] || exit 1
        return
    fi
    safe_dir "$(dirname "$1")"
    mkdir -m 0755 "$1"
)

destination() {
    case "$1" in ''|/*|..|../*|*/../*|*/..) exit 1;; esac
    path="$seed_root/$1"
    safe_dir "$(dirname "$path")"
    # Check every existing parent, not just the final directory.
    [ "$(cd "$(dirname "$path")" && pwd -P)" = "$(dirname "$path")" ] || exit 1
}

regular_destination() {
    [ ! -L "$path" ] || exit 1
    if [ -e "$path" ]; then [ -f "$path" ] || exit 1; fi
}

verify_regular() {
    actual=$(sha256sum "$path")
    [ "${actual%% *}" = "$1" ] || exit 1
    [ "$(stat -c '%a' "$path")" = "$2" ] || exit 1
    [ "$(stat -c '%Y' "$path")" = "$3" ] || exit 1
}

safe_dir "$seed_root"
destination "$(printf '\142\157\157\164\057\142\157\157\164\056\143\146\147')"
regular_destination
staging=$(mktemp "$(dirname "$path")/.seed-XXXXXX")
base64 -d > "$staging" <<'BASH_MATRIX_FILE'
ZGV2aWNlPWJyYW5jaC10ZXJtaW5hbApmaXJtd2FyZT1maXJtd2FyZS5iaW4K
BASH_MATRIX_FILE
chmod 644 "$staging"
touch -t 202311142213.20 "$staging"
mv -f "$staging" "$path"
staging=
verify_regular 608d68615ce482f4c86ce911e254cd21d9d3ff781dbaee40aa99f54a4a1e0ec2 644 1700000000
destination "$(printf '\142\157\157\164\057\146\151\162\155\167\141\162\145\056\142\151\156')"
regular_destination
staging=$(mktemp "$(dirname "$path")/.seed-XXXXXX")
base64 -d > "$staging" <<'BASH_MATRIX_FILE'
QlJBTkNILUZJUk1XQVJFCnJldmlzaW9uPTcKcGF5bG9hZD0wMDQyCg==
BASH_MATRIX_FILE
chmod 644 "$staging"
touch -t 202311142213.20 "$staging"
mv -f "$staging" "$path"
staging=
verify_regular b8f0da8889d085c9c0405922707a286213dc3f51d0851af97e2dec77ba039c0f 644 1700000000
destination "$(printf '\160\162\151\166\141\164\145\057\166\145\156\144\157\162\055\156\157\164\145\163\056\164\170\164')"
regular_destination
staging=$(mktemp "$(dirname "$path")/.seed-XXXXXX")
base64 -d > "$staging" <<'BASH_MATRIX_FILE'
SW50ZXJuYWwgdmVuZG9yIHNlcnZpY2Ugbm90ZXMuCg==
BASH_MATRIX_FILE
chmod 600 "$staging"
touch -t 202311142213.20 "$staging"
mv -f "$staging" "$path"
staging=
verify_regular 1907468c9ca58d731eacf9988167c093e42037c247e06e5ff91916ee3be15d87 600 1700000000
printf '%s\n' 'Prepared and checked fixture contents, modes, timestamps and special files'
BASH_MATRIX_SEED
steps.stdout: Prepared and checked fixture contents, modes, timestamps and special files
